en: Monochrome image of a large stone church surrounded by leafless trees and enclosed by a low masonry wall. The church has a tall, square central tower with a steep pyramidal roof topped by a small finial or cross. The nave and side structures have sloped roofs, and there is a small chapel or gatehouse by the entrance in the wall. The style suggests a medieval or early modern rural church in Northern or Central Europe. The overall format and border indicate it is a vintage postcard. No visible printed caption or handwriting appears on the front.
